description: Creates a new Post for the authenticated user, or edits an existing Post when edit_options are provided. Media in media.media_ids is attached in the order given; get the ids by uploading each image with Upload Media, or a video with Initialize Media Upload. Supports paid partnership disclosure via the paid_partnership field. To share a clip of another Post's video, set clip to that Post's id and a range of 5 to 60 seconds.
